errors.text_span: Диаграмата е разделена на четири сектори
errors.evidence: The chart is a nested donut chart with two rings (an outer and an inner), each comprising three sectors, for a total of six sectors. The description incorrectly states it is a single chart with four sectors.

errors.text_span: Вторият сектор, оцветен в жълто, показва 57.9% разговори, класифицирани като „Частично“.
errors.evidence: The value 57.9% corresponds to the inner red sector, which is categorized as "Deceived". The description incorrectly assigns this value to a yellow sector categorized as "Partially".

errors.text_span: Третият сектор, оцветен в зелено, показва 31.6% разговори, маркирани като „Не измамени“.
errors.evidence: The value 31.6% corresponds to the inner yellow sector, which is categorized as "Partially". The description incorrectly assigns this value to a green sector categorized as "Not Deceived".

errors.text_span: Четвъртият сектор, оцветен в тъмнозелено, показва 23.5% разговори, маркирани като „Ambigiuity 2 (Inner)“.
errors.evidence: The value 23.5% corresponds to the outer yellow sector, categorized as "Partially". The description incorrectly states its color is dark green and its category is "Ambigiuity 2 (Inner)", which is the name of the inner ring, not a data category.

errors.text_span: Няма етикети с проценти вътре в проекциите на секторите.
errors.evidence: The description claims there are no percentage labels inside the sectors, which is false. All six sectors have their percentage values clearly displayed within them (e.g., 67.6%, 57.9%, etc.).

The description completely omits the key structural feature of the chart, which is that it is a nested donut chart showing data for two separate conditions: "Ambiguity 1 (Outer)" and "Ambiguity 2 (Inner)".

errors.text_span: разпределението на разговорите, които са били измамени
errors.evidence: The description of the chart's purpose is incomplete. It states the chart shows the distribution of 'deceived' conversations, but it actually shows the distribution of three outcomes: 'Deceived', 'Partially', and 'Not Deceived'.

errors.text_span: This pie chart represents the distribution of conversations categorized by their level of deception, as indicated within the "Distribution of deceived conversations (%) across varying degrees of ambiguity" caption. The chart includes five slices
errors.evidence: The figure is a nested donut chart with two rings, not a single pie chart. It has a total of six slices (three in the outer ring and three in the inner ring), not five.
The description completely omits the central organizing feature of the chart: the comparison between two distinct datasets, "Ambiguity 1 (Outer)" and "Ambiguity 2 (Inner)".

errors.text_span: a green slice labeled “Not Deceived” at approximately 31.6%
errors.evidence: The value 31.6% corresponds to the "Partially" category (a yellow slice) in the inner ring. The "Not Deceived" categories have values of 8.8% and 10.5%.

errors.text_span: a large red slice representing “Deceived” at approximately 67.6%, followed by a yellow slice labeled “Partially” at around 31.6%
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly mixes data from the two separate rings as if they belong to a single chart. The 67.6% value is from the outer ring ('Ambiguity 1'), while the 31.6% value is from the inner ring ('Ambiguity 2').
The description omits two of the six data points shown in the chart: the 57.9% value for "Deceived" in the inner ring and the 8.8% value for "Not Deceived" in the outer ring.

errors.text_span: The slices appear to be ordered in descending size
errors.evidence: This claim is false. The description presents the values in a jumbled order from two different datasets (e.g., 67.6%, 31.6%, 23.5%), which is not a descending sequence. The chart does not present a single ordered set of slices.
The slice is yellow, not orange.

errors.text_span: a legend is present below the chart
errors.evidence: The two legends are located to the right of the chart, not below it.
